# stalwart_index_queue_status (Resource)

Represents the processing state of a search index queue.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `status` (Attributes) Current processing state of the queue (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
- `index` (String) Search index the queue belongs to
- `partition` (Number) Account or telemetry bucket the queued documents belong to
- `queued_deletions` (Number) Number of documents awaiting deletion from the index
- `queued_updates` (Number) Number of documents awaiting indexing

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `next_retry` (String) Date and time when indexing will be retried
- `reason` (String) Error reported by the last indexing attempt
